init.title: ConnectHome Butler Options
init.description:
Options apply immediately without restart.

**Show hidden devices**: changing this option reloads all entities. When turning it off, any previously visible hidden entities will be removed automatically. If you see stale unavailable entities, restart the integration.

data.room_name_in_title: Add room name to entity titles

data_description.room_name_in_title: Appends the Butler room name in parentheses, e.g. "Switch (Kitchen)"
data_description.poll_enabled: Keeps a persistent connection to the Butler controller for instant state updates
data_description.poll_interval: Used only when real-time polling is disabled
data_description.entity_prefix: Prepended to all entity names, e.g. setting "Butler" results in "Butler Switch"
data_description.force_refresh: After every action (turn on/off, set temperature), immediately fetches the updated device state
data_description.show_hidden: Reloads all entities. Hidden devices are Z-Wave endpoints normally hidden in Butler UI
